name: neko-aria-suite
description: NEKO — desktop AI VTuber companion and ARIA — Jarvis-style assistant (Electron + Vue + VRM)

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run build:electron && electron ."
scripts.dev:neko: concurrently "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run build:electron && electron . --persona=neko"
scripts.dev:aria: concurrently "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run build:electron && electron . --persona=aria"
scripts.build:neko: vite build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --config.productName=NEKO --config.appId=com.neko.neko
scripts.build:aria: vite build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --config.productName=ARIA --config.appId=com.neko.aria
